recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-43178 unless the work group later chooses to revisit the separate lazy-evaluation/cache wording for constants.
issue_request: FHIR-43178 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureMap clarification asking whether map-level constants can depend on source/context variables and when those expressions are evaluated. The R6 resolution required replacing the ambiguous sentence with text saying expressions are evaluated each time a map is evaluated, are FHIRPath expressions, and because constants are map-level they can refer to other constants but cannot access source and target variables.
initial_application: FHIR-21642 introduced the constants section in source/mapping-language.html with the ambiguous sentence. Commit 4ca72903b8bb6bbe73fb451536a6a5c69fda4d36, titled 'FHIR-43178 StructureMap const definition dynamic behavior unclear', replaced that sentence with the approved clarification. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-43178 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: source/mapping-language.html is an active page through source/hierarchy.xml, and StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini. The linked Zulip thread gathered limited community feedback without a conflicting conclusion, and FHIR-I WGM minutes record discussion of what constants are and how they are evaluated with a 13-0-3 vote matching the Jira. Later mapping-language commits on the combined branch did not remove or contradict the clarification.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current combined branch already contains the approved wording at source/mapping-language.html:249-252, and searches did not find another active source location retaining the older ambiguous rule.
